description: Marx's theory of historical materialism posits that history is driven by conflicts between forces of production and relations of production, leading toward a post-capitalist society.

instances.assertion: Marx's theory of historical materialism posits that history is driven by conflicts between forces of production and relations of production, leading toward a post-capitalist society.
Marx argued that the driving force of history is the material conditions and the mode of production.
